_doc: Static facts of the CURRENT campaign. Never written by a run. Starting a new campaign = edit this file, then `node scripts/new-campaign.js <archive-id>` (see RUNBOOK → New campaign).
_dates: Friday itself is 27 Nov 2026. Amazon.sa runs 19–30 Nov and Noon (Yellow Friday) 20–30 Nov per Time Out Riyadh, read 19 Nov 2026; other stores differ and each store's own page wins. campaignEnd is the last day a run refreshes.

theme._doc: Each campaign carries its own colour (Mahmoud, Oct 2026): green was National Day, blue was Blue Week. White Friday is ink on white. The verified/ok green is semantic and is NOT part of the theme.
